Alias.name: (whobe) Who Information about charcater
Alias.script:
-- Alias pattern: -- ^whobe\s*(.*)$
local name = (matches[2] or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if name == "" then cecho("<yellow>Usage: whobe <person>\n") return end
send("whoisic " .. name) send("whois " .. name)
-- Run local DslColors alias, not a game command. expandAlias("dslcolor show person " .. name, false) --expandAlias("dslcolor combat show " .. name, false)

Alias.name: (MYMOTD) My Message of the day and notes
Alias.script:
local WIDTH = 70
local function borderTop() cecho("<dim_gray>╔" .. string.rep("═", WIDTH) .. "╗<reset>\n") end
local function borderMid() cecho("<dim_gray>╠" .. string.rep("═", WIDTH) .. "╣<reset>\n") end
local function borderBottom() cecho("<dim_gray>╚" .. string.rep("═", WIDTH) .. "╝<reset>\n") end
local function motdLine(color, text) local padding = WIDTH - #text - 2
if padding < 0 then padding = 0 end
cecho("<dim_gray>║ <" .. color .. ">" .. text .. string.rep(" ", padding) .. " <dim_gray>║<reset>\n") end
local function motdTitle(text) local left = math.floor((WIDTH - #text) / 2) local right = WIDTH - #text - left
cecho("<dim_gray>║" .. string.rep(" ", left) .. "<deep_sky_blue>" .. text .. string.rep(" ", right) .. "<dim_gray>║<reset>\n") end
cecho("\n") borderTop() motdTitle("***MY MESSAGE OF THE DAY***") borderMid()
motdLine("sienna", "Start Journal Note") motdLine("sienna", "Catch up on notes") motdLine("sienna", "Pause and think of a plan") motdLine("sienna", "Type out full commands (practice)")
borderMid()
motdLine("green", "FOCUS") motdLine("OrangeRed", " - MUDSCHOOL") motdLine("purple", " - questinfo questoptions stat worth") motdLine("brown", " - make new area maps like New Thalos") motdLine("gold", " - Continue your work on the Draconus and Cliath") motdLine("gold", " - Work on swapping out outfits, in preparation for gear")
borderBottom() cecho("\n")
